# Pattern Review: Brackenford Hall

## Input Quality and Limitations

The complete log covers two events in one month, with one occurrence per distinct event. Each diagnosis has supporting evidence: the technician reproduced the failure and a targeted intervention removed it. This is still a very small sample.

## Summary

| Candidate | Occurrences | Distinct Instances | Cause Consistency | Confidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| “The projector cuts out” | 2 | 2 | Different confirmed causes | High that the symptom recurs, not a shared cause |
| Damaged cable | 1 | 1 | Confirmed in E1 only | High for this isolated diagnosis |
| Power-off timer | 1 | 1 | Confirmed in E2 only | High for this isolated diagnosis |

## Genuine Patterns

No repeated underlying cause is demonstrated. The same symptom occurs at both events, but that does not establish a common driver.

## Misleading Surface Patterns

E1 and E2 both report “The projector cuts out.”

- E1, event A, room 1: a damaged cable was confirmed; replacement removed the fault.
- E2, event B, room 2: a timer was confirmed to be powering the projector off; disabling it removed the fault. The cable tested healthy.

The matching wording supports a recurring symptom. The different diagnoses, including E2’s healthy cable, argue against treating these as one causal pattern. Confidence is high within this log because both failures were reproduced and resolved through different targeted interventions.

## Isolated Signals, Not Yet Patterns

- Damaged cable: E1, one occurrence in one distinct event.
- Power-off timer: E2, one occurrence in one distinct event.

Both are supported diagnoses, but neither recurs across distinct instances.

## Suggested Actions for Human Approval

Have a person check the diagnoses and decide whether either isolated issue warrants further attention. Retain separate cause labels when reviewing future incidents; the repeated symptom alone does not justify a common fix or process change.

## What This Sample Cannot Tell You

These two events cannot establish how common either cause is, whether either will recur, or whether Brackenford Hall has a wider equipment or maintenance problem.
